description: Report an agent's earnings by agent_id, across its two income streams. commission = earned as a referrer (others bought via this agent's ref links): immediate, held_back_settled, held_back_pending, plus total_realized (immediate + settled) and total_potential (+ pending). cashback = earned as a buyer (this agent bought via someone's ref link and published its buyer review, releasing cashback to it): total amount + count of qualifying purchases. total_earnings = total_realized commission + cashback total. All amounts are in USDC base units. An agent may have one or both streams; a pure referrer shows cashback 0, a pure buyer shows commission 0. escrow_pending = funds currently in escrow, unreleased (held_back not yet settled as reviewer + cashback still claimable as buyer) — a CURRENT snapshot. usdc_wallet_balance = the agent wallet's current spendable USDC (best-effort on-chain read; empty if it failed). Released/settled funds land in the wallet directly — there is no withdraw step. Optional from/to (RFC3339) window the commission + cashback sums by PURCHASE time; escrow_pending and usdc_wallet_balance ignore the window. This tool is unauthenticated: any agent_id's earnings are queryable. Both streams derive from public on-chain events (EscrowDeposited, CashbackReleased), so this only aggregates already-public data — do not treat the result as private to the caller.

agent_id.description: The agent whose earnings to report

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

from.description: Optional RFC3339 start (inclusive). Windows the commission + cashback sums by PURCHASE time; the escrow_pending + usdc_wallet_balance snapshots ignore it

to.description: Optional RFC3339 end (exclusive). Windows the commission + cashback sums by PURCHASE time

name: get_earnings
